_comment: Settled design decisions. check_locks.py fails when furnish.js or a built model breaks one; Edit AI refuses to save an edit that breaks a lock unless the request names it (one of the lock's 'names'; it then saves and marks the lock 'suspended' with the request so pushes go on); the pre-push hook (.githooks) refuses a push. To change a lock on purpose: change the design AND the numbers here in the same commit, with the new decided_by/date.

locks.what: Reception column face (Main / Karim's) at plan x 17.542 (DWG 207.9471), as the DXF and survey draw it, not the inflated 17.862.
locks.ref: db36c26 (flush to real column), 0a5a7de (Edit AI rebuild re-inflated it), 9c69130 (column --cut in Edit AI rebuild)

locks.what: Reception TV library (TV box) face flush with the column face: item x + TV box depth = 17.542.
Option A: keep the 8 cm step and the splayed curve; tall niches ~21 cm deep (run 0.2122), TV niche ~29 cm (TV box 0.2922), splay 0.08 out over 0.20.
Dining buffet niche = the TV wall's tall niche opening: 0.34 wide, 0.42-2.20 high, r 0.13, shelves 0.86 / 1.30 / 1.74, same family/curve.
locks.ref: Notion execution notes (buffet same curve and niche size as TV library), 8e25b0f

locks.what: Reception TV wall horizontal layout (local x along the wall, +x = north toward the column; item at plan y 3.67; free wall = south wall face local -1.60 / plan y 2.0705 to column local 1.72 / plan y 5.3914): TV 166.81 x 95.78 cm centred at local 0.44 (plan y 4.11), never past the column; low niche centred on the TV ([-0.45, 1.33]); splayed return at local -0.51 (splay from -0.71); two tall niches centred in the leftover run -1.60..-0.71 at [-1.53,-1.19] and [-1.12,-0.78] (0.07 margins and gap).
locks.ref: t311 (centre the TV wall, niches centred in the space left, low niche centred on the TV)
